summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for File Browser: Modified column + sortable headers + grid sort dropdown. Logged in as admin, selected SORT_sftp storage (12 items), verified list & grid views, exercised all sort interactions, and ran regression on search + preview. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Sort logic in Files.jsx (line 244-254) is clean: folders-first invariant preserved, missing modified dates default to 0 which is safe.
SortHeader button uses class 'overline' — verify this custom utility exists in tailwind config (used elsewhere in codebase — pre-existing pattern, not a new issue).
Files.jsx is now 680 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting SortHeader, ItemMenu, and Rename/Move dialogs into separate files in future work.
seed_data_creation: None (SFTP already contained SORT_sftp fixture files).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SORT_sftp storage has 12 items (1 folder 'upload', 11 files across .bash_logout/.bashrc/.profile/banner.png/photo.png/notes.txt/config.json/data.csv/dokumen.pdf/rekap.xlsx/laporan.docx). Verified: (a) Modified column shows human-readable date '24 Jul 2026, 11:55 PM' between Size and Actions; folders show '—' for size (not Modified — Modified shows the folder's mtime when backend provides it). (b) sort-name/-size/-modified testids toggle asc/desc; active header turns blue with ArrowUp/Down icon; folders always stay grouped on top. Confirmed size-desc puts laporan.docx (36 KB) first among files, size-asc puts notes.txt (50 B) first; modified-desc puts most-recent files first, modified-asc puts .bash* files (07 May) first. (c) grid-sort-button opens dropdown with Name/Size/Date modified items; selecting them reorders the grid cards. (d) Regression pass: search filter, preview modal (PNG), view toggle, storage sidebar all still functional.
